items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Joe or Leon -- was Leon Henderson around? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they did come later. Leon, yeah.

ctx.x: Was Joe or Leon -- was Leon Henderson around? Joe must have come later. Leon’s his brother -- Leon.
Yeah, they did come later. Leon, yeah.
So how did you get to the U.S. military? Why did you do that?
